name: Wuhan Good Morning 2021
information:
# The competition is cancelled due to COVID-19.

The structure of the competition in Wuhan this year has been modified due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
Competitors are only allowed to compete in one of the two competitions, **[Wuhan Good Morning 2021](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Wuhan-Good-Morning-2021)** and **[Wuhan Good Afternoon 2021](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Wuhan-Good-Afternoon-2020)**, in two half-days respectively.
